member.name: T:OwnVocalRemover.HTDemucsAudioSeparator
member.summary: HTDemucs-based audio separation service for stem extraction. Optimized for streaming processing with minimal memory footprint. Uses OwnAudioEngine converters for high-performance audio processing.
member.remarks:
HTDemucs (Hybrid Transformer Demucs) separates audio into 4 stems: - Vocals: singing and speech - Drums: percussion instruments - Bass: bass guitar and low-frequency instruments - Other: all other instruments
Performance characteristics: - CPU processing: ~10-15x realtime (16 cores) - GPU processing: ~50-100x realtime (CUDA) - Memory footprint: ~500-800 MB for 10s chunks

member.name: T:OwnVocalRemover.MultiModelAudioSeparator
member.summary:
Multi-model audio separation service with averaging across multiple UVR MDX models. Processes audio through multiple models in parallel and averages their outputs. Each model processes the original audio independently, then vocals and instrumentals are averaged separately across all models.
Example use case: Model 1: High-quality vocal separation (outputs vocals) Model 2: Another vocal model with different characteristics (outputs vocals) Model 3: Instrumental-focused model (outputs instrumental) Result: Averaged vocals and averaged instrumental with better quality than any single model
Important: Configure each model's OutputType (Vocals or Instrumental) to handle models that output different stems.
